name: Солдат гарнизона
notes: A line soldier of the Kragmir army detachment that holds the fort in the deep mines, a generic type fought in numbers. The fort holds the known route to Ssir-Ket, homeland of the Пауки-Оборотни, and the drill shows it: alchemist's fire against webs, arbalests to shoot climbers off the walls, halberds to shove attackers back. The garrison is a separate force from the mines guard and always fights to kill. Table note: Formation is a toggle; switch it on while the soldier stands adjacent to at least two allies.

actions.name: Formation
actions.text: When it's adjacent to at least two other allies, the soldier gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 to Reflex saves against area effects.

actions.name: Crowd Control
actions.text:
Requirements The soldier's last action was a successful halberd Strike

Effect The soldier attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Reposition] the creature they hit using their halberd's reach. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the soldier's multiple attack penalty.

actions.name: Shoot Down
actions.text: The soldier carefully makes a ranged Strike. If the Strike deals damage, the target must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:24|options:inflicts:prone] saving throw or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone].

actions.name: Dwarven Doughtiness
actions.text: Dwarves are often calm and collected in the face of imminent danger. At the end of the soldier's turn, reduce its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened] condition by 2 instead of 1.
